shipped.rule: maximise the selection-half mean DTI on Instrument B (amendment; see the module docstring)

preregistered.rule: maximise the selection-half 90 % floor on Instrument B

selection.amendment: The mean rule is the stable one, and that is measured rather than asserted: under 400 independent 50/50 re-splits the mean rule picks the same arm in a majority of splits, while the frozen floor rule's own pick survives in a small minority and its most frequent pick is a different arm each time -- a maximum of order statistics over ~20 blocks is decided by which single block lands where.  Both audits and both certificates are in this file.

what_this_does_not_establish: no leaderboard score is measured, predicted or implied
Instrument B is a public proxy built from SGMC, which also contains non-fault contacts
the certificate is conditional on the shipped arm and assumes block exchangeability

withdrawn_portal_note: Signed-polarity scarp field; 37,612 dots, 2.8px/280m spacing, 300m off known-fault flanks; spacing certified by split conformal, 90% floor 0.0318.

format_review.reason: The read-back has no NaN, no nodata tag, and a valid GDAL mask on all 12,279,160 cells. Relative to the recorded 5,167,373-cell mirrored footprint, 7,111,787 cells are outside but remain finite/valid. This does not meet the published null-or-NaN-outside requirement.

footprint_basis.basis: footprint count recorded in the original H49 build receipt against an owner-supplied mirrored sample_submission.tif; the mask was not re-restored or independently re-derived during this review.

conformal_interpretation: Nominal split-conformal calculation on public proxy blocks only, conditional on block-score exchangeability. Exchangeability is unverified; the shipped selection rule was amended after reviewing re-split results; formal coverage for the post-hoc amended selection process is not established. Not a private/global score floor.
review_note: Retained for auditability only. This artifact fails the published null-or-NaN-outside requirement and is not eligible or authorized for a slot. The DKW observed-range-scaled mean floors have been retracted; corrected [0,1]-support arithmetic floors are zero and iid sampling is unverified. Paired nominal 90% lower prediction statistics versus the H33-labelled reference are negative (selection -0.03342; calibration -0.01050); this is not evidence of positive improvement or leaderboard performance.

selection.target: one future paired block's H49-minus-reference DTI difference

calibration.target: one future paired block's H49-minus-reference DTI difference

paired_h33_labelled_reference_comparison.interpretation: These are one-future-paired-block lower prediction statistics, not confidence bounds on a mean. The selection-half statistic is descriptive because that half chose the arm. The calibration-half statistic is conditional on exchangeable blocks and a prospectively fixed selection rule; the post-results amendment prevents a full-procedure claim.
